# <img src="FirebirdTraceAnalyzer/Assets/app-logo-rounded.svg" width="30" height="30" alt="Firebird Trace Analyzer logo" />&nbsp; Firebird Trace Analyzer

**A professional application for processing and analyzing `Firebird 5.x` trace files generated by the `fbtrace` utility. The solution was developed to address the shortcomings of existing tools and offers a comprehensive approach to database performance analysis.**

## Advantages over competitors
- **The main advantage of the application is the ability to process trace logs in various ways—whether they are local files or located on a remote server.**
- The application is designed to handle large trace files efficiently, ensuring that even logs with millions of events remain responsive.
- The application provides a rich set of filtering and search capabilities, allowing users to easily find and analyze specific events within the trace logs.
- The application includes an optional local event store, which allows users to store and manage trace events in a SQLite database with features such as deduplication, storage analytics, and on-demand compaction.

## Highlights

- **Load logs multiple ways** — local files or remotely over **SSH/SFTP** (with trust-on-first-use host-key verification and secure credential storage).
- **Rich filtering & search** — multi-select, numeric/date ranges, full-text search and stable sorting.
- **Optional local event store** (SQLite/WAL) with deduplication, storage analytics, on-demand compaction and a read-only SQL console.
- **Live report designer** — group, aggregate and preview, then export to **PDF, DOCX, XLSX or CSV**.
- **Extensible** via drop-in sort/filter plugins.
- **Light / Dark / Auto themes** and **English / Russian** localization.

## Getting started

### Download

Prebuilt builds for Windows, macOS and Linux are on the [**Releases**](https://github.com/deliciousNesquik/firebird-trace-analyzer/releases) page — download, unpack and run.

### Build from source

Requires the [.NET 10 SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deliciousNesquik/firebird-trace-analyzer.git
cd firebird-trace-analyzer

dotnet run --project FirebirdTraceAnalyzer      # run
dotnet test FirebirdTrace.sln                   # run the tests
```

**To build your local release version, use the guide located at the following path:** [Build Guide](build/README.md)
